argv.notes: Chopsticks launches one loopback `opencode serve` backend with an environment-only Basic-auth password, then launches `opencode attach` for the exact native session ID.

http.notes: Authenticated loopback REST control and durable state. Event names use `http/<OpenAPI operationId>`; record schemas retain exact HTTP method and templated route.

sse.notes: GET /event emits native `{id,type,properties}` records. No replay cursor was observed; reconnect requires durable HTTP rehydration and entity reconciliation.

terminal.notes: The real OpenCode TUI attached to the shared backend and exact session. It can be the blocker controller; terminal pixels are not the semantic observation rail.
